purpose: CPU-only exploratory test of whether the existing saved model samples contain complementary experimental states. No GPU generation, per-family model choice or promotion from an oracle support bound.
selection: Use the first declared number of selected retry outputs from each head for every family. No reference-informed sample or family-specific head selection. Preserve existing frozen2A/CA0.8/coarse-valid state assignments.
support_bound: Union of states reached by all32 selected outputs from all four models:128 existing outputs per family. This is an observed-sample support bound, not a32-sample deployment pipeline or a claim about all possible model outputs.
decision: Report coverage, both-state families, validity and oracle CA-lDDT for each fixed32 mixture, with paired-family changes versus original32. No GPU mixture test unless a fixed mixture gains>=0.1 coverage with positive lower95% bound and CA lower bound>-0.005, with validity difference>=-0.01. No mixing-weight grid. Full48-family MD and native/timing qualification would still be required.
scope: All16 existing two-state development families; original34 and reserved17 unscored. This diagnostic is motivated after seeing the four-model aggregate results, not a preregistered confirmation test.
